label: Insurance Agency
local_angle: Helping local individuals, families, and businesses find the right coverage from multiple carriers, not just one.
seasonal_calendar: Auto and home insurance shopping often rises at policy renewal time and after severe local weather events; life and business insurance inquiries stay fairly steady year-round.

niche_table.title: What Each Policy Actually Covers
rows: Dwelling damage, personal property, liability, additional living expenses
Vehicle owners and drivers — required by law in most states
Personal property and liability, plus additional living expenses — not the building itself
A death benefit paid to your beneficiaries; term and whole life differ in duration and cash value
Anyone with dependents or financial obligations others rely on
General liability, property, workers' compensation, and business interruption, depending on the policy
Extra liability coverage above your home or auto policy's limits
Anyone wanting protection beyond their standard policy limits

safety_toolkit_items.heading: Your State Department of Insurance
safety_toolkit_items.text: Every licensed insurance agent is registered with their state's insurance regulator. Confirm an agent's license status before you buy a policy.

safety_toolkit_items.text: The leading credit rating agency for the insurance industry — check a carrier's real financial-strength rating before trusting them to pay a future claim.
